svg.title: How often the better transaction goes first, held or arriving later
svg.desc: For each validator, the share of pairs in which Y landed before A: when the leader held both (C4), and when Y was sent 2, 10 or 40 ms after A while the leader was producing (W2, W10, W40), with 95% intervals.
svg.text: share of pairs, 0 at a panel’s bottom, 100% at its top
Y sent 2, 10, 40 ms after A, inside the window
